metadata.name: PowerTwin 4D Knowledge Base
metadata.purpose: Promote rapid modular data center construction through 4D modeling, physics-aware digital twins, 800V DC power architecture, and diversified intelligent supply chain planning.
metadata.positioning: A reference layer for Jane Yang’s personal exploratory project on modular data center design, energy systems, and 4D construction planning.

research_papers.label: 4D schedule intelligence
research_papers.thesis: Linking 3D components with schedule activities makes construction sequences easier to evaluate, communicate, and optimize before field execution.
research_papers.productUse: Use each data center pod as a queryable 4D object with design, procurement, steel, power, cooling, rack-load, and operations states.

research_papers.label: MEP coordination and prefab
research_papers.thesis: VDC is strongest when it coordinates mechanical, electrical, plumbing, prefabrication, and field constraints before installation.
research_papers.productUse: Treat rectifier skids, 800V busway, liquid headers, rack shelves, and steel bays as co-designed modules.

research_papers.label: Semantic 3D scene graph
research_papers.thesis: A semantic graph can unify spaces, objects, geometry, cameras, and relationships into a queryable digital twin.
research_papers.productUse: Represent site, foundation, steel, power, cooling, compute, software, and telemetry as OpenUSD-like layers and graph nodes.

research_papers.label: 4D scan progress
research_papers.thesis: Sparse repeated scans need temporal identity tracking to understand evolving built environments.
research_papers.productUse: Compare weekly scans against planned module state, flag deltas, and update readiness scores.

construction_process.name: Land + grid screen
construction_process.visualLayer: Site parcels, substation distance, queue risk, water/air gates
construction_process.decision: Choose a site only if power interconnect, permitting, geotech, and logistics can converge inside the target time-to-power window.

construction_process.name: Geotech + foundation engine
construction_process.visualLayer: Soil class, piles, mat thickness, bearing and settlement heatmap
construction_process.decision: Foundation should be calculated from site class, liquefaction, groundwater, seismic tier, rack mass, skid mass, and steel bay loads.

construction_process.name: Modular steel frame
construction_process.visualLayer: Columns, beams, braces, module connections, crane sequence
construction_process.decision: Steel bays become the repeatable product unit: each bay carries racks, liquid loop, busway, scan status, and commissioning state.

construction_process.name: 800V DC power path
construction_process.visualLayer: MV feed, SST/rectifier, DC busway, sidecar storage, rack shelf
construction_process.decision: AI rack density pushes power design from legacy in-rack voltage toward facility-level 800V DC with storage and protection modeled as first-class objects.

construction_process.name: Liquid + thermal loop
construction_process.visualLayer: Supply/return headers, cold plates, heat rejection, pressure drop
construction_process.decision: Liquid cooling geometry must be co-optimized with steel bay, rack power, and service access before releasing modules.

construction_process.name: Rack compute + AI factory OS
construction_process.visualLayer: GPU/ASIC racks, fabric, scheduler, telemetry, rollback
construction_process.decision: Construction is not done when racks are installed; workload scheduling, observability, security, and rollback determine load-readiness.

construction_process.name: Operations digital twin
construction_process.visualLayer: Live telemetry, simulation readiness, anomaly and supply chain events
construction_process.decision: The operating twin should keep construction, power, cooling, compute, software, and supply chain data live after handoff.

supply_chain.thesis: Fast modular AI data center construction depends on an intelligent multi-vendor supply chain, not a single-vendor building package.
supply_chain.planningBoundary: Lead times and risk scores are design-stage assumptions. Replace them with supplier quotations, reserved production slots, qualified alternates, logistics commitments, and site-specific permit dates before investment approval.

strategies.label: Balanced
strategies.intent: Global best-source procurement with standard schedule buffers.

strategies.label: Dual source
strategies.intent: Parallel qualification, reserved factory slots, and regional alternates.

strategies.label: US localized
strategies.intent: Localize power, steel, integration, and service while retaining global silicon.

globalNodes.alternate: Qualified container, PCS, and cell packages
Open telemetry and Modbus acceptance contract

tiers.label: Compute platforms
tiers.role: Rack-scale GPU, ASIC, CPU, and networking architecture drives power, cooling, steel, and software assumptions.

tiers.label: Power semiconductors
tiers.role: GaN, SiC, controllers, protection, and high-voltage conversion components determine 800V DC efficiency and availability.

tiers.label: Power systems
tiers.role: SST/rectifier, switchgear, busway, metering, sidecar storage, protection, and serviceability become modular product interfaces.

tiers.label: Factory integrators
tiers.role: Prefabricated steel, power skids, busway, and cooling assemblies compress field work if design freeze happens early.

tiers.label: Site delivery
tiers.role: Geotech, civil, steel, utility, and permitting partners localize the design engine to California parcels and constraints.

tiers.label: Software and twin layer
tiers.role: OpenUSD-like scene graph, simulation, telemetry, scheduler integration, and procurement intelligence convert construction progress into live decisions.

power_architectures.label: Utility grid
power_architectures.path: MVAC utility feed > switchgear > SST/rectifier > 800V DC bus > rack sidecar
power_architectures.firming: Utility capacity and interconnect study required

power_architectures.label: Behind-the-meter gas
power_architectures.path: Gas train > modular generator blocks > MV switchgear > SST/rectifier > 800V DC bus
power_architectures.firming: Fuel delivery, emissions permit, black start and common-mode review required

power_architectures.label: Aeroderivative gas turbine
power_architectures.path: Firm gas > DLE aeroderivative turbine > MV generator > switchgear > SST/rectifier > 800V DC bus
power_architectures.firming: Firm gas transport, air permit, SCR, acoustics, islanding, black start and seismic turbine mat required

power_architectures.label: Behind-the-meter solar
power_architectures.path: PV field > DC combiner > grid-forming inverter > storage > 800V DC bus
power_architectures.firming: Solar alone is not a 24/7 firm critical source; storage and dispatch studies are required

backup_architectures.designIntent: Use a multi-timescale continuity stack: rack DC-link for sub-cycle transients, 800V sidecar or supercapacitor for fast cycling, LFP BESS for the generator-start bridge, and N+1 standby generation for long-duration outages.

publicationBaseline.label: 15 minute BESS bridge + 48 hour HVO standby
publicationBaseline.topology: Rack DC-link > 800V sidecar > LFP BESS > N+1 HVO generator plant > protected onsite fuel

backup_architectures.boundary: Autonomy and fuel consumption are planning screens, not vendor guarantees. Final values require the selected engine curve, ambient derating, emissions controls, reserve loading, usable battery state of charge, degradation allowance, and local code review.

reliability_method.method: Series component availability, binomial N+1 capacity probability, independent 2N path probability and explicit backup transfer probability.
reliability_method.boundary: The result is an engineering screening estimate, not Uptime Institute certification and not a contractual uptime guarantee.

design_principles: Use the module as the unit of capital, construction, power, cooling, compute, and operations.
Make every 3D object time-aware, source-aware, and supply-chain-aware.
Calculate foundation and structural assumptions from site and load inputs instead of using fixed defaults.
Show uncertainty and blockers visually; investors should see why time-to-power changes.
Treat 800V DC, liquid cooling, rack compute, and software readiness as one commissioning path.
Keep the product vendor-diverse: optimize across suppliers, not only inside one ecosystem.
Do not present solar without storage and grid-forming controls as a firm critical source.
Do not translate reliability screening percentages into Tier certification claims.
